campaign.title: First Signal
briefs: Fly down from the marked start to the opposite border. Close your line to reveal the side without a field enemy.
Enclose the gold relay as well as reaching the coverage target. Scan shows hidden information; a captured relay stays restored.
Two enemies can preserve both sides of a cut. A secured line still gives you a new starting point.
Walls block movement. Bend your route around them, then reconnect to blue safe ground.
A border patrol makes the outer rail dangerous. Watch its direction before waiting on the edge.
A required relay is hidden. Scout can reveal it; its location can also be captured through an ordinary cut.
The sentinel warns before activating a lane. Wait for the recovery window or protect your line with a shield.
Combine coverage, a relay and the sentinel warning. Choose your next cut, then commit.
The amber zone slows ordinary craft. Fiber ignores interference, but its cable is still the vulnerable live trail. Switch at the home hangar before choosing your cut.

Return to either hangar to change craft without restarting. Carriers collect charges at pads; stun fields covering an emitter suppress its signal zone while the field lasts. A field never captures territory by itself.

Each cut has a six-second deadline and a fifty-cell cable budget. The whole attempt lasts seventy seconds. Close shorter cuts to build new launch points; neither a shield nor fiber bypasses these limits.

The final storm combines two signal zones, a moving field pair, a lane warning and a mission clock. Scan, shield, supply fields, fiber and impact are alternate tools; safe-hangar switching never refills ammunition or resets cooldowns.

classRecipes.label: Scout
classRecipes.description: Mark hidden objectives permanently; show enemy direction hints for four seconds. No slowing.

classRecipes.label: Light carrier
classRecipes.description: Pick up one charge at a supply pad; drop a field that stuns nearby field enemies.

classRecipes.label: Heavy carrier
classRecipes.description: Carry two charges; each creates the same temporary stun field.

classRecipes.label: Interceptor
classRecipes.description: Absorb one enemy or lane contact: cancel the cut and recover at spawn without losing a life. Self-crossing remains dangerous.

classRecipes.label: Fiber relay
classRecipes.description: Ignore signal interference and scan for hidden relays. Your cable is the live trail: enemy contact still breaks it.

classRecipes.label: Impact craft
classRecipes.description: Release a close-range stun pulse, abandon the unfinished cut and redeploy at home without losing a life. The pulse never captures territory.

classRecipes.label: Trapper
classRecipes.description: Pick up one charge and place a four-second field that slows field enemies to one quarter speed.
